title: Adecco Group rolls out Agentforce Coworker to 27,000 staff in 40-plus countries
summary: The Adecco Group is rolling out Salesforce’s Agentforce Coworker across more than 40 countries following a pilot in the UK and France, the staffing group announced on September 15. The group said the rollout brings agentic AI into the daily workflows of 27,000 employees. Agentfor
